scope: Paper additions: support graph figure and twelve-cube criterion. No Lean sources changed in this revision.
figure_check_method: Parsed the TikZ support edges; checked twelve varieties, degree two, corner coverage and usable counts against the tableau; counted buildable targets by augmenting-path matching.
criterion_proof: Eight usable physical copies per target imply the row-bound inequalities. At total twelve these give row and column sums two and symmetric support. The degree argument leaves four support types; corner coverage excludes the three bipartite types. The surviving two-triangle inventories are universal by the constructive sufficiency lemma.
formal_scope: The corollary has a complete written proof but no separate Lean statement. Concurrent Lean refactoring is outside this paper revision; its manuscript paragraph update was preserved.
thirteen_cube_example: Remains a candidate optional remark in the literature review; not added to the manuscript.
